pipeline.title: Merck, Eisai’s Welireg-Lenvima combo lands FDA nod to jump the kidney cancer queue
pipeline.summary: Merck & Co. has scored an FDA approval for its blockbuster-to-be Welireg to move into second-line treatment of kidney cancer, where analysts have projected a rapid uptake.

pipeline.title: Elevar wins FDA nod for bile duct cancer drug Lyrfigtu, a first for a Korean firm
pipeline.summary: The FDA has green-lighted Elevar’s FGFR2-selective inhibitor Lyrfigtu in bile duct cancer, making it the first novel cancer drug from a Korean company to secure FDA approval.

pipeline.title: Acadia misses mark in Alzheimer’s but concludes phase 3 ‘absolutely worth’ pursuing
pipeline.summary: Acadia Pharmaceuticals’ phase 2 Alzheimer’s disease trial has missed its primary endpoint, but the company and analysts alike saw enough encouraging signals to support the continuation of a phase 3 program.

pipeline.title: Merck sees pivotal victory for $3B eye disease prospect
pipeline.summary: Merck & Co.’s Brunello trial has hit its primary endpoint, shedding light on the effects of a trispecific diabetic macular edema (DME) drug candidate that the Big Pharma bought in a $3 billion takeover.

pipeline.title: 9 pharma leaders sound ‘alarm bells’ on biotech’s decline in Europe
pipeline.summary: Frustrated by a slump that’s seen Europe lose ground to the U.S. and China, several top drugmakers are calling for speedier clinical trials, intellectual property protections and “fiscal flexibility.”

pipeline.title: Immunovant ends cutaneous lupus program after phase 2 flop
pipeline.summary: Immunovant has stopped development of IMVT-1402 in cutaneous lupus erythematosus after failing a midphase test, closing off one path to market for the anti-FcRn antibody.

pipeline.title: Roche’s phase 3 win tees up fight with Novartis for blockbuster kidney disease market
pipeline.summary: Roche has reported a phase 3 win for sefaxersen in kidney disease, teeing up talks with regulators about the path to approval for the Ionis-partnered, would-be blockbuster candidate.

pipeline.title: This week in charts: Novo’s rise and fall and AI biotechs’ big haul
pipeline.summary: The latest installment in BioPharma Dive’s data visualization series features a closer look at Novo's stock performance and the recent run of fundraising success for AI drug discovery startups.

pipeline.title: Lundbeck to move US digs to Boston as it eyes bigger innovation frontiers
pipeline.summary: With Lundbeck steering its R&D engine toward increasingly specialized neuroscience targets, the Danish drugmaker is plotting a U.S. HQ move to one of the country’s preeminent biopharma hotspots.

pipeline.title: Fierce Pharma Week: A look at the biggest trends, campaigns and conversations
pipeline.summary: Fierce editors recap the biggest trends, campaigns and conversations from Fierce Pharma Week, from GLP-1 marketing and AI to celebrity campaigns and what stood out on the show floor.

pipeline.title: Novo pursues long-acting obesity drugs; Acadia slumps on Alzheimer’s data
pipeline.summary: Novo’s latest alliance involves injectables given every one to three months. Elsewhere, Nektar won a legal spat with Eli Lilly and the FDA issued two approvals.

pipeline.title: Fierce Pharma Asia—Lilly’s $3.35B InnoCare deal; Korea’s breakthrough; China’s 5-year biotech plan
pipeline.summary: Eli Lilly and InnoCare Pharma inked a multi-target deal potentially worth $3.35 billion. The FDA has doled out the first approval for a novel cancer drug from a Korean company. China's new pharmaceuticals five-year plan includes some ambitious goals. And more.

pipeline.title: Eli Lilly blasted for ‘promotional and emotive’ language in GLP-1 press release
pipeline.summary: A U.K. watchdog has scolded Eli Lilly over a press release the drugmaker sent to the BBC, arguing that its use of “promotional and emotive” language brought discredit on the pharma industry.

pipeline.title: Lilly brings more heat to Novo with FDA nod for once-weekly insulin Onswik
pipeline.summary: After racking up a trio of regulatory wins overseas, Eli Lilly’s once-weekly insulin is coming home to open a new front in the company’s ongoing market showdown with Novo.

pipeline.title: Indivior ends PAM drug collab with Addex ahead of Supernus merger
pipeline.summary: Ahead of its upcoming merger with Supernus, Indivior Pharmaceuticals has ended its long-running collaboration with Addex Therapeutics to develop positive allosteric modulators (PAMs).

pipeline.title: Novo inks $1.3B Nanexa deal to unlock long-acting obesity injectables
pipeline.summary: Novo has struck a 1.17 billion euro ($1.3 billion) deal to combine Nanexa’s long-acting injectable drug delivery platform with its obesity and Type 2 diabetes drugs.

pipeline.title: Roche's Genentech inks $1.5B bispecific pact with fast-rising Earendil
pipeline.summary: Roche’s Genentech is paying Earendil Labs $55 million upfront to discover and develop multiple bispecific antibodies. The deal, which focuses on oncology, includes milestones that could take the deal's value above $1.5 billion.

pipeline.title: ADARx scores upsized $446M IPO, while fellow RNA biotech City maps out Nasdaq plans
pipeline.summary: ADARx Pharmaceuticals has overshot its own IPO ambitions, as fellow RNA-focused biotech City Therapeutics also plans a public listing.

pipeline.title: Pioneer of China NewCo model sued in US over trade secret misuse, double-dealing
pipeline.summary: A legal feud unfolding in New York is putting a spotlight on the work of a business development veteran who is credited for pioneering one of biopharma’s hottest dealmaking mechanism: the China “NewCo” model.

pipeline.title: RNAi drug specialist ADARx raises $446M IPO
pipeline.summary: ADARx is the only maker of RNA-based drugs to go public since 2024 and the first RNAi biotech to price an IPO in the U.S. in more than a decade.

pipeline.title: Former 'Real Housewives' star Jenn Fessler and CineHealth’s Tracey Yaw break down authentic healthcare storytelling
pipeline.summary: Former 'Real Housewives of New Jersey' star Jenn Fessler and CineHealth festival director Tracey Yaw highlighted the empowering and widespread impact of sharing patient experiences during a panel and interview at Fierce Pharma Week.

pipeline.title: Grail multicancer detection test wins FDA advisers’ backing
pipeline.summary: Panel members said the first-of-a-kind blood test should not be used to replace medical guideline-recommended cancer screenings, however.

pipeline.title: FDA nominee Overton parries vaccine questions at Senate hearing
pipeline.summary: Pressed by lawmakers on Thursday, Trump’s pick as the next FDA chief said she’d “follow the law” on key decisions and work to speed early drug research.

pipeline.title: Chutes & Ladders—Travere chief makes way for former Amicus CEO
pipeline.summary: Travere Therapeutics CEO Eric Dube, Ph.D., is stepping down after overseeing the launch of the rare kidney disease drug Filspari.

pipeline.title: Trump's FDA pick Heidi Overton calls vaccines, mifepristone safe and effective in confirmation hearing
pipeline.summary: The Senate Committee on Health, Education, Labor and Pensions (HELP) today questioned Heidi Overton, M.D., Ph.D., Trump’s pick for FDA commissioner, in a hearing marked by tightrope-walking on issues like vaccines, abortions, flavored vapes and whether or not President Donald Tru

pipeline.title: GSK slammed for ‘grossly misleading’ and ‘totally unacceptable’ behavior
pipeline.summary: GSK showed a “totally unacceptable” lack of transparency in its interactions with the PMCPA, the U.K. self-regulatory body ruled.

pipeline.title: Merck reveals study success, and possible safety worries, for eye drug hopeful
pipeline.summary: A medicine acquired in a $1.3 billion buyout came through in the first of two pivotal studies in diabetic macular edema, though language regarding the drug’s safety stirred debate among analysts.

pipeline.title: Boehringer Ingelheim offloads Shanghai CDMO to local antibody developer
pipeline.summary: Boehringer Ingelheim is bidding adieu to its biologics contract manufacturing unit in China, inking a small-scale deal that gives local developer Raas Blood Products an established biologics production base for its lead antibody drug candidate.

pipeline.title: Lilly’s latest China drug deal; Immunovant’s setback in lupus
pipeline.summary: Lilly wagered up to $3.35 billion in its fourth China-focused alliance since January 2025. Elsewhere, analysts are now more confident about one of Vertex’s top prospects and an RNA drug succeeded against a rare form of ALS.

pipeline.title: China’s Henlius carves out $440M T-cell engager deal with Amberstone
pipeline.summary: Fosun Pharma subsidiary Henlius Biotech has signed a $440 million biobucks deal with California-based Amberstone Biosciences to work on T-cell engagers.

pipeline.title: Glaukos courts NBA champion Stephen Curry for new keratoconus awareness campaign
pipeline.summary: Glaukos is teaming up with four-time NBA champion, two-time NBA Most Valuable Player and Olympic gold medalist Stephen Curry for a new “Could it be KC?” campaign.

pipeline.title: Otsuka JV recalls one lot of sodium chloride over labeling issue
pipeline.summary: Otsuka ICU Medical, a joint venture from Japan’s Otsuka Pharmaceutical Factory, issued a voluntary recall of one lot of 0.9% sodium chloride injection for IV due to a possible mix-up of labels.

pipeline.title: Roche pens backloaded $2B deal with Atavistik to discover allosteric CVRM drugs
pipeline.summary: Roche has penned a backloaded $2 billion deal with hematology biotech Atavistik Bio to develop allosteric small molecules for cardiometabolic diseases.

pipeline.title: Adagio Medical kicks off strategic review, trims more than half its staff
pipeline.summary: Adagio Medical has initiated a strategic review of its business and will lay off more than half its full-time workers as the maker of cryoablation devices faces delisting on the Nasdaq exchange.

pipeline.title: Biogen springs social media kidney health campaign with Olympic gymnast Suni Lee
pipeline.summary: Biogen has teamed with gymnast Suni Lee for a campaign, leveraging the Olympic gold medalist’s health journey and social media audience to vault deeper into kidney health awareness.

pipeline.title: Lilly puts up $100M, plus billions on the backend, to form 5-target deal with China's InnoCare
pipeline.summary: Eli Lilly has committed $100 million in upfront and near-term payments to InnoCare Pharma to form a five-target drug discovery pact. The deal features up to $3.25 billion in milestones.

pipeline.title: Grail survives adcomm vote as it awaits FDA decision for cancer blood test
pipeline.summary: Despite a major trial setback earlier this year and increasing questions over its efficacy, medtech Grail has beaten the odds and seen a positive recommendation for its multi-cancer blood test Galleri from FDA advisors.

pipeline.title: Kyverna ‘resetting conversation’ with 1-year miv-cel data as autoimmune CAR-T peers hit safety snags
pipeline.summary: As two Big Pharma players in the autoimmune CAR-T space face unexpected safety setbacks, Kyverna Therapeutics is reporting long-term clinical data that showcase sustained efficacy alongside an unblemished safety profile for its potential first-in-class candidate, miv-cel.

pipeline.title: Enveda, an AI drugmaker, banks $311M in venture funding
pipeline.summary: Enveda, which is using AI tools to mine plants and microbes for drug prospects, has three candidates in human testing for immune diseases and obesity.

pipeline.title: Roche, Ionis RNA drug scores in kidney disease study
pipeline.summary: The results position Roche to bring a new kind of medicine to market for IgA nephropathy, a disease that’s drawn considerable attention of late from drugmakers.

pipeline.title: Novo CEO sees advantages in souping up NYSE listing: report
pipeline.summary: The Ozempic and Wegovy maker's CEO said he's open to a direct listing of Novo's shares on the New York Stock Exchange, but no such transition is currently underway.

pipeline.title: Eli Lilly CEO touts 70% share as Medicare GLP-1 program reaches 700K seniors
pipeline.summary: Sign-ups for Medicare’s GLP-1 coverage plan keep expanding, and Eli Lilly is dominating the market with 70% share, the company’s CEO David Ricks said.

pipeline.title: Cellares pens 2nd automation test with Asia-based cell therapy partner in 2 weeks
pipeline.summary: Despite hitting a speed bump over the summer, automated cell therapy manufacturing specialist Cellares has continued to sign new partners at a steady pace, now inking a second agreement with an Asia-based organization in just over a week.

pipeline.title: Trump's Department of War bets $47M on Flagship biotechs to develop countermeasures
pipeline.summary: The Department of War has awarded Flagship Pioneering $47 million to develop medical countermeasure technologies against emerging threats.

pipeline.title: Enveda reaps $311M series E to feed ambition to become a ‘household name’
pipeline.summary: Enveda has raised a $311 million series E round, positioning the nature-derived drug discovery company to pursue its goal of becoming a household name over the next decade.

pipeline.title: Boehringer adds $250M to value of Variant pact by expanding into cardiovascular disease
pipeline.summary: Boehringer Ingelheim has dived deeper into its collaboration with Variant Bio by expanding the collaboration to cover cardiovascular disease to the tune of $250 million.

pipeline.title: AstraZeneca recommits to youth health to dial funding past $100M
pipeline.summary: AstraZeneca has re-upped its UNICEF-partnered Young Health Programme, committing to a new five-year phase that will move total investment in the initiative above $100 million.

pipeline.title: 'The growth driver of our organization'; Genentech CMO Zoë Lazarre on experimental marketing, AI and the ‘last mile gap’
pipeline.summary: Genentech's chief marketing officer Zoë Lazarre, Ph.D., likens AI to a “armor, or a digital backpack” that her teams can use for better, faster insights, she said during an interview at Fierce Pharma Week.

pipeline.title: Bristol Myers cuts another 265 jobs tied to New Jersey headquarters
pipeline.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb plans to lay off another 265 employees tied to its corporate headquarters in New Jersey, bringing the number of total job reductions the company has announced this year in the Garden State to more than 700.

pipeline.title: GSK aiming to ‘balance West and East’ after Hansoh deal success showed China’s potential
pipeline.summary: GSK has been operating a strategy of “balancing the West and the East” since the Big Pharma’s eyes were opened to the potential of licensing drugs from China two years ago, according to an executive.

pipeline.title: 'Europe does not value what you do': 9 pharmas make urgent call for bloc to beef up innovation muscle
pipeline.summary: As China and the U.S. presently duke it out over biopharma innovation supremacy, a clutch of Europe’s biggest drugmakers are calling on the bloc to not lose sight of its R&D roots.

pipeline.title: Travere CEO Eric Dube to step down after transforming the rare disease biotech
pipeline.summary: Eric Dube, Ph.D., the CEO who rebranded Travere Therapeutics and oversaw the launch of its rare kidney disease drug Filspari, will step down to “focus on his health and family.” Bradley Campbell, formerly CEO of Amicus Therapeutics, will take the reins.

pipeline.title: Par Health recalls IV sedative in US, flagging presence of cellulose, stopper material
pipeline.summary: Par Health issued a voluntary recall of two lots of the IV sedative dexmedetomidine HCl in 0.9% sodium chloride injection that may be contaminated with cellulose or stopper material.

pipeline.title: Anaconda Biomed snares $56M in funding for endovascular tech
pipeline.summary: Medtech startup Anaconda Biomed has hauled in $53 million to help finish off work on a pivotal trial for its endovascular project.

pipeline.title: Organon-commissioned survey finds 1 in 3 UK women feel their migraine pain not taken seriously
pipeline.summary: One in three women in the U.K. feel their migraine pain “is taken less seriously by others because of their gender.”

pipeline.title: ‘It’s actually very radical’: NIH debuts tool to help scientists navigate biomedical database
pipeline.summary: The NIH’s National Library of Medicine has released the pilot version of a new tool designed to help scientists plumbing the library’s digital trove of scientific papers find related research faster.

pipeline.title: Why a US senator wants a biotech leader in the White House who ‘has the president’s ear’
pipeline.summary: Senator Todd Young (R-IN), chairman of the National Security Commission on Emerging Biotechnology, told Fierce why he's concerned about the growth of China's biopharma industry.

pipeline.title: Regulatory tracker: EC win marks 3rd asthma approval for AZ's Breztri
pipeline.summary: In this tracker, Fierce Pharma is recording the regulatory progress of in-market products, including expansions into key geographies and new indications. Some of these updates may not meet the bar for standalone stories, but we think they are still worth mentioning.
